daily.brief: 過去約25小時內，52個帳號發出305則相關帖文。共識最集中在光子學主題的$LITE，同時$INTC因指引下調成為共同看淡對象。最大分歧出現在$GOOGL，股價回調後分析師目標價仍高達375-425美元。
daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最明顯的是$LITE，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文23則。@kevinxu 直說希望有人做了光子學的夢，滿倉看漲期權會很傳奇。原帖 @aleabitoreddit 報告$MRVL正處於收購$LITE的最終階段，試圖以激光垂直整合解決供應瓶頸，若成功將提升其他激光業者價值。原帖 @StockSavvyShay 則強調$MRVL到FY2029利潤增長近10倍至約140億美元，希望在超大規模企業持續增加AI支出下獲得優勢。

共同看淡

$INTC有3個帳號看淡。@hkuppy 提醒別忘了2000年，半導體狂熱在英特爾爆炸時結束，第四季指引大幅下調（調整後EPS 0.25美元對預期0.43美元）後盤後暴跌。原帖 @munster_gene 指出主要問題是PC需求因高記憶體成本放緩，不應外推至$NVDA。

分歧

$GOOGL是今日被提及最多的代號（66次），但看法明顯分裂。@Mr_Derivatives 指出儘管下跌10%，所有主要分析師仍有巨大目標價，範圍從375美元至425美元，仍較現價高30-47%，問是否買入回調？原帖 同時@TheTranscript_ 報導Alphabet執行長表示AI工具幫助工程師多交付35%的程式碼並減少30%的錯誤。原帖 有人看到基本面強勁，有人擔心盤後拖累市場。

其他值得留意

$IWM小型股今日表現相對強勢，@Mr_Derivatives 表示盤後幾乎觸及283美元，過去一週有不錯反彈。原帖 $CVNA財報超預期，零售單位銷售+39%至紀錄新高，盤後上漲8%，@michaelsikand 提到一位18億美元對沖基金經理有80%資金做多。原帖 $MU方面，有帳號看好未來18個月內可能達到1700美元，指空頭將再次被證明錯誤，因自由現金流預期已大幅上調。

短摘要

過去約25小時內，52個帳號發出305則相關帖文。共識最集中在光子學主題的$LITE，同時$INTC因指引下調成為共同看淡對象。最大分歧出現在$GOOGL，股價回調後分析師目標價仍高達375-425美元。

weekly.brief: 過去7日共1837則帖文，來123個帳號。共同看好集中在$SKHY和$SOFI（各7個帳號），共同看淡則以$BA為主。最大分歧出現在$SPY和$MU。
weekly.full:
共識

過去一週共同看好最集中的是$SKHY和$SOFI，各有7個帳號看多。@ripster47 建議苦苦掙扎的交易者要記錄可重複的設置，在財報季$SKHY今日是無壓力的4R交易，只需不斷上移止損。原帖 @ThetaWarrior 引用早前提示，表示掃單者獲利了結總利潤超遀400萬美元。$SOFI方面，@Jake__Wujastyk 指出月線蟸燭有相當的恢復，@RedDogT3 表示近期少見像昨日財報後這樣的形態，策略是以跳空缺口樞鈐位為參考做多波段。

共同看淡

$BA有4個帳號看淡。@Mr_Derivatives 直說BA今天下跌10%，創1.5年新低。原帖 其他看淡包括$ENPH財報遜預期後下跌約14-20%。

分歧

$SPY和$MU分歧明顯。$MU有14個帳號看多、2個看淡，有帳號看好18個月內至1700美元。$TSLA和半導體ETF$SMH也有多方聲音，但整體市場在FOMC後反應不一。

其他值得留意

半導體板塊ETF投資者積極買入下跌，涉及$SMH $SOXL $DRAM。$LITE光子學主題延續至週線，與每日共識一致。

monthly.brief: 過去28日共6083則帖文，來155個帳號。共同看好以$SOFI和$LITE為主，共同看淡持續集中在$BA。最大分歧是$CRWV（6多24淡）和$SPY。
monthly.full:
共識

過去一個月共同看好最集中的是$SOFI（8個帳號）和$LITE（5個帳號）。光子學和金融科技主題在更長時間框架上延續。其他包括$MSTR、$RSP和$AEHR也有5個帳號看多。

共同看淡

$BA持續有4個帳號看淡，與週線一致。其他共同看淡包括$TMUS、$SBUX和$ENPH。

分歧

$CRWV分歧最極端，6個帳號看多但24個看淡。@KeithMcCullough 表示AI泡沫已開始破裂，從新雲開始，CoreWeave於10月23日收於54.24美元，較52週高點大幅回落。原帖 相反，有帳號指出即使$GOOGL也無法足夠快上線產能以滿足需求，對$CRWV等有利。$TSLA有22個帳號看多、3個看淡，$SPY則12多13淡。

其他值得留意

整體上，AI相關分歧（尤其新雲和半導體）在月度框架最明顯，而傳統防禦或消費股則較少共同看多。

daily.brief: Over the past ~25 hours, 52 accounts posted 305 related items. Strongest consensus is bullish on photonics name $LITE, while $INTC is the common bearish name after guidance cut. Biggest divergence is on $GOOGL, where analyst targets remain 375-425 after the drop.
daily.full:
Consensus

Today's clearest common bullish is on $LITE, with 4 accounts explicitly long and 23 related posts. @kevinxu said a full position in call options would be legendary if someone dreamed about photonics.post @aleabitoreddit reported that $MRVL is in the final stages of acquiring $LITE to vertically integrate the laser bottleneck.post @StockSavvyShay highlighted $MRVL's nearly 10x profit growth to ~$14B by FY2029 as hyperscalers keep increasing AI spend.

Common Bearish

$INTC has 3 accounts bearish. @hkuppy reminded not to forget 2000, when the semiconductor frenzy ended with Intel exploding; the stock plunged after Q4 guidance was cut sharply (adj. EPS $0.25 vs $0.43 expected).post @munster_gene said the main issue is PC demand slowing due to high memory costs and should not be extrapolated to $NVDA.

Divergence

$GOOGL was mentioned most (66 times) but views are split. @Mr_Derivatives noted that despite a 10% drop, major analysts still have huge targets from $375 to $425, 30-47% above current price — buy the dip?post Meanwhile @TheTranscript_ reported the Alphabet CEO saying AI tools help engineers deliver 35% more code and reduce errors by 30%.post

Other Notable

$IWM small caps were relatively strong; @Mr_Derivatives said it almost touched $283 after hours with a solid rebound over the past week.post $CVNA beat, with retail unit sales +39% to a record and +8% after hours. $MU has a view of potentially reaching $1,700 within 18 months.

weekly.full:
Consensus

Strongest common bullish over the week were $SKHY and $SOFI, each with 7 accounts. @ripster47 advised struggling traders to journal repeatable setups; $SKHY was a stress-free 4R trade on earnings day by trailing stops.post On $SOFI, @Jake__Wujastyk noted solid recovery on the monthly candle and @RedDogT3 said the post-earnings pattern is rare, with a strategy of trading the gap pivot.

Common Bearish

$BA had 4 accounts bearish. @Mr_Derivatives simply said BA is down 10% today, a 1.5-year low.post

Divergence

$MU showed 14 bullish vs 2 bearish accounts, with a $1,700 target within 18 months mentioned. $SPY was more balanced.

Other Notable

Semiconductor ETF buyers stepped in on dips ($SMH, $SOXL). The $LITE photonics theme carried over from the daily view.

monthly.full:
Consensus

Over the month the clearest common bullish names were $SOFI (8 accounts) and $LITE (5 accounts). Photonics and fintech themes persisted.

Common Bearish

$BA continued with 4 accounts bearish, consistent with the weekly view. Others included $TMUS and $SBUX.

Divergence

$CRWV was the most extreme: 6 bullish vs 24 bearish. @KeithMcCullough said the AI bubble has started to burst, starting with new cloud, noting CoreWeave closed at $54.24 on Oct 23, well off its 52-week high.post Counter-views cited capacity shortages even at $GOOGL as supportive for names like $CRWV. $TSLA had 22 bullish vs 3 bearish.

Other Notable

AI-related names showed the widest splits over the longer window, while traditional names were quieter on the consensus side.
